answer: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.c0006) FROM t0000 p JOIN t0002 l ON l.c0039=p.c0006 WHERE l.c0043 IN ('+','2+','3+','4+') AND p.c0005 IS NULL

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t0000 p WHERE p.c0002='-'
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM t0002 l WHERE l.c0039=p.c0006 AND (l.c0033<=29 OR l.c0033>=52))
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM t0002 l WHERE l.c0039=p.c0006 AND CAST(l.c0002 AS REAL)>16)

SELECT ROUND(AVG(l.c0041-8.5),3) FROM t0002 l JOIN t0000 p ON p.c0006=l.c0039
WHERE p.c0000='F' AND l.c0041>8.5 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM t0001 e WHERE e.c0006=p.c0006 AND e.c0008 LIKE '%SLE%' AND e.c0008 NOT LIKE '%susp%' AND e.c0008 NOT LIKE 'JRA->%')
SELECT SUM(p.c0000='F') AS women, SUM(p.c0000='M') AS men FROM t0000 p WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM t0002 l WHERE l.c0039=p.c0006 AND CAST(l.c0002 AS REAL)>32)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c0006) FROM t0001 WHERE c0004>0 AND c0005>='1997-01-01' AND c0005<='1997-12-31'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t0000 p WHERE p.c0000='F' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM t0002 l WHERE l.c0039=p.c0006 AND l.c0029 IS NOT NULL AND CAST(l.c0029 AS REAL)<8)

SELECT p.c0006, p.c0000, l.c0031, l.c0022 FROM t0000 p JOIN (SELECT c0039, c0031, c0022, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c0039 ORDER BY c0031 DESC) rn FROM t0002 WHERE c0022 IS NOT NULL) l ON l.c0039=p.c0006 AND l.rn=1

SELECT p.c0001 FROM t0000 p JOIN t0002 l ON l.c0039=p.c0006 WHERE l.c0003<60 AND p.c0006 IN (SELECT c0039 FROM t0002 WHERE CAST(c0002 AS REAL)>=16)
GROUP BY p.c0006, p.c0001 ORDER BY MAX(l.c0003) DESC, p.c0006 ASC LIMIT 3

SELECT CAST(strftime('%Y',l.c0031) AS INTEGER)-CAST(strftime('%Y',p.c0001) AS INTEGER)-(strftime('%m-%d',l.c0031)<strftime('%m-%d',p.c0001)) AS age, p.c0004 AS diagnosis FROM t0002 l JOIN t0000 p ON p.c0006=l.c0039 WHERE p.c0002='+' AND l.c0029 IS NOT NULL ORDER BY CAST(l.c0029 AS REAL) DESC, l.c0031 ASC LIMIT 1

WITH last AS (SELECT c0039 id, MAX(c0031) d FROM t0002 GROUP BY c0039)
SELECT SUM(p.c0000='F') - SUM(p.c0000='M') FROM last JOIN t0002 l ON l.c0039=last.id AND l.c0031=last.d JOIN t0000 p ON p.c0006=last.id WHERE CAST(l.c0002 AS REAL)>=32
SELECT c0004 FROM t0000 WHERE c0002='+' AND c0003>='1998-02-15' AND c0003<='1998-02-28' ORDER BY c0001 ASC, c0006 ASC LIMIT 1
SELECT ROUND(AVG(c0001),1) FROM t0001 WHERE c0005>='1993-10-01' AND c0005<='1993-10-31' AND c0008 LIKE '%SLE%' AND c0008 NOT LIKE '%susp%' AND c0008 NOT LIKE 'JRA->%'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t0000 WHERE LOWER(c0004) LIKE '%psoriatic arthritis%'
SELECT p.c0000 AS sex, COUNT(*) AS patients FROM t0000 p WHERE p.c0000 IN ('M','F') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM t0002 l WHERE l.c0039=p.c0006 AND l.c0003>=60) GROUP BY p.c0000

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t0000 p WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM t0002 l WHERE l.c0039=p.c0006 AND l.c0007 IN ('negative','0'))
AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM t0001 e WHERE e.c0006=p.c0006 AND e.c0004>0)
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM t0002 l WHERE l.c0039=p.c0006 AND l.c0022 IN ('30','100','300','>=300','>=1000','+1(30)','+2(100)'))
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.c0006) FROM t0000 p JOIN t0002 l ON l.c0039=p.c0006 WHERE p.c0000='F' AND l.c0021>3.5 AND l.c0021<9.0 AND (l.c0013<=150 OR l.c0013>=450) AND CAST(l.c0002 AS REAL)>15
